problem: Fresh exact-preview cross-browser evidence left two CLS regressions: /ai-modelwijzer tablet (0.126) and Wet-DBA blog desktop (0.200).
root_cause: The metric-compatible local @font-face fallbacks are unavailable in the CI/browser runtime, so font-display:swap temporarily used a much wider system font. Instrument Sans text measured 505px in fallback versus 441px as webfont, causing extra lines and 31–63px vertical reflow.
decision: Keep font-display:swap, but preload the current Latin variable WOFF2 resources for Instrument Sans and Bricolage Grotesque in the final site build before first meaningful layout.
prevention: Every public page receives both critical font preloads through the existing lettertype-terugval build step.
The cross-browser CLS threshold remains 0.1; it is not widened.
Daily and PR screenshot assurance will detect a future Google font-version drift or lost preload.
